basis.governing_question: Why did export margins fall in 2025 at Vinhos do Douro Lda?

phases.name: Diagnostic
phases.objective_one_line: Establish why export margins fell in 2025 by examining pricing in each export market and distributor terms.

gate.label: Findings sign-off
gate.decision: Does the steering group accept the findings on why 2025 export margins fell?

workstreams.name: Pricing by export market
workstreams.answers: How did prices and margins develop in each export market, and where did they fall in 2025?
activities: Analyze sales and cost data for each export market
Interview the people who set export prices
Compare realized prices across export markets

deliverables.name: Price and margin by export market
Findings on the 2025 export margin decline

workstreams.name: Distributor terms
workstreams.answers: Which distributor terms apply in each market, and how did they affect export margins in 2025?
activities: Review distributor contracts and agreed terms by market
Interview the people who manage distributor accounts
Compare distributor terms with realized margins

events.label: Kick-off
events.purpose: Align on scope, data and interviews
events.decision: Do the CEO and the Export Director confirm the scope and the data access needed?
agenda: Present the plan of work and the two workstreams
Align on access to sales, cost and distributor data
Confirm who the team interviews on the client side

events.label: Findings sign-off
events.purpose: Accept findings on the margin decline
events.decision: Does the steering group accept the findings on why 2025 export margins fell?
agenda: Present findings on pricing by export market and distributor terms
Review margin drivers with the CEO and Export Director
Decide whether the findings are accepted

architect_notes: The plan is one four-week Diagnostic phase because the brief states four weeks and a quick diagnostic; confirm no further phase is expected.
Archetype performance_improvement is the closest fit; its Implementation phase is dropped because the engagement is an assessment.
The two workstreams are the ones the brief names, replacing the archetype's Baseline and Opportunity sizing, so no opportunity sizing is in the plan.
